value.content:
Pip is scared when a big thunderstorm rolls over the meadow. #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl teaches him a simple trick: count slowly between the flash and the rumble, so loud noises don't feel so scary anymore.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #ThunderstormHelp #PipTheBunny #CalmBedtime
